notes: Explicit primary-PDP labels are tied to exact SKU through public mindboxData.sku and canonical URL.
Only Organization JSON-LD was observed in the examined sample PDPs; no product Offer.availability was used.
This records what the cached source explicitly says. It is not a live warehouse reservation and does not establish delivery dates, quantities or regional stock.
Unknown is not equivalent to out-of-stock. Generic buy buttons, related-card labels and absence from the first catalogue page were never used.
Есть в N магазинах is explicit physical-store stock, recorded as in-stock with evidence.availabilityChannel and storeCount. It does not assert delivery readiness.
